reason: Honestly the free version is the part I want: ranges instead of a fake 28-day guess and a PDF I can show my doctor. I'd download it and try it, but I'm not paying $5 a month on my budget for an AI write-up when I don't know yet if the free predictions are any better than Flo's.
objection: Every app says it gets irregular cycles and then it's still wrong for me. I'd need a couple of months of the free version actually being right before I trust an AI to tell me anything, especially whether my metformin or inositol is doing something.
would_change_my_mind: If after a few months the free ranges were actually right for me and the Pro write-up could clearly show whether my metformin or inositol is changing my cycles or symptoms, I'd pay for the yearly plan.
